Figure 3(a) displays the F1 curve for different methods under varying levels of label noise. The x-axis represents the "污染率" (label noise rate), ranging from 0 to 0.585 in increments of 0.1. The y-axis represents the F1 score, ranging from 55.0 to 72.5 in increments of 2.5.

The figure contains three lines, each representing a different method: "Teacher", "Self-Training", and "PST". 

- The red line (Teacher) starts at approximately 70.5 and decreases to approximately 61.5 at x=0.585. 
- The blue line (Self-Training) starts at approximately 69.5 and decreases to approximately 60.5 at x=0.585. 
- The green line (PST) starts at approximately 71 and decreases to approximately 62 at x=0.585.

These lines show a downward trend as the label noise rate increases.
